title: Guarantees by Construction for Learned Finite Volume Schemes on Steady Supersonic Flow
summary: A second order finite volume scheme rests on two local quantities: a gradient reconstructed in each cell, and a limiter which scales it down where the reconstruction would overshoot. Both are set by fixed formulas, and on coarse unstructured meshes a small network can supply better values. But a network is free to output anything, and the usual safeguard is a penalty in the training loss, which discourages inadmissible states without preventing them. We replace the penalty by a hard constraint. The network still sets both quantities, and every value it can produce lies inside safe bounds:…
